title: record_status
description:
Robot -> client. The reply to every record verb, and the whole recording state each time -- it is a snapshot, not a delta, so a client that misses one is not left inconsistent.

`ok: false` is an ordinary outcome, not a transport error: "already recording an episode", "not recording", "nothing to discard", "already uploaded -- cannot discard". A client polling with action "status" against a robot that has recording disabled will see ok:false routinely, so treat it as state rather than raising.

Field availability depends on stack and service support. Older L2/L3 peers omit the review fields and request_id; only type and ok are required. A supporting L3 gateway echoes request_id only when supplied. Treat absent review_supported as unsupported and never satisfy a correlated waiter with an uncorrelated legacy reply.

stereo.description: L3: echoed on every reply while a session opened with stereo capture is open, and only then -- the UI reports stereo enforcement solely from this echo, so a robot predating the vocabulary stays silent rather than promising. Fixed at session open; a mid-session flag on the verb is ignored.

session.description: L2: the session directory name, e.g. "20260729T201358Z-nori-l2-1002". Absent on L3, which has no session directory.

episodes_kept.description: Episodes kept in this gateway collection. Review-mode Stop does not increment; successful Keep does, once per ID. Legacy Stop counts immediately. This is not upload status.

episode.description: Display ID of the open episode, or null when none is open. Accept both L3 episode-NNNN and L2 <session>/episode-NNNN shapes. Match the trailing segment for the episode number. On review-capable L3, use the separate stable episode_id for Keep/Reject; the display ID is not a review identifier.

free_gb.description: Free space on the recording volume.

dropped_frames_est.description: L2: estimated dropped frames per camera role for the open episode. Empty when no episode is open.

queue_drops.description: L2: cumulative writer-queue drops for the process.

error.description: Set when ok is false. NOT guaranteed present: the L3 gateway can emit ok:false with an empty service message, which it then omits. Do not rely on this to explain a failure.

request_id.description: Echoed for a correlated request on supporting L3 gateways; omitted for legacy requests and older peers. An absent or different ID cannot complete a correlated request.

review_supported.description: True only when the robot review service is available. Do not assume support when absent.

episode_id.description: Stable ID of the started/stopped/resolved episode; distinct from the display-only episode field.

active_review_episode_id.description: Owned active capture restored by review_status; empty if none.

decision.description: An interrupted decision must be retried as-is.

episode_removed.description: Successful review-mode Stop had no payload and removed the empty episode; do not offer Keep/Reject.
